Subject: Hightower Health POC — recap & proposed next steps

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we’re all aligned and to capture agreed next steps.

Summary of needs: 
- Use case: customer support resolution summaries and triage routing for 2 pilot queues (~3000 tickets/mo).
- Data constraints: PHI redaction required; on-prem option preferred for initial pilot.
- Success metrics: 90% high-quality summaries (QA sample), <300ms median latency on short prompts, and cost target ~<$0.002/token.

Mutual action plan (attached): I’ve attached a one-page MAP that lists owner and timing. High-level proposed timeline:
- This week: tech kickoff and access to a small dataset + credentials (Hightower).
- Week 2: integration demo + first test run on private deployment.
- Week 3: evaluation and go/no-go decision.

Immediate asks:
1) Can you share a sample (anonymized) ticket and the expected summary style by Friday?
2) Point us to the infra contact who will provision VPN/K8s access for the on-prem trial (cc Samir if that’s you).

I’ve cc’d Marcus from our solutions team to scope the private deployment checklist and timeline. Marcus — can you add any missing pieces to the MAP and confirm typical time to spin up a private test?

Thanks — happy to jump on a short follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Hi Olivia / Samir — Marcus from Redwood here. Short technical note and a checklist to help unstick the private trial setup. I’ve attached our on‑prem checklist and included the minimal items we need to start a smoke test:

Minimal test checklist (quick):
- Network: VPN or peered VPC + allowed egress to 34.89.12.0/22 (redwood test IP)
- Credentials: short-lived service account + sample S3 bucket (anonymized)
- Resources: 1x GPU node (T4 equivalent) or allow Redwood test nodes on your subnet
- Data: 50–100 sample tickets (anonymized) and expected summary labels

I can run the environment provisioning call and stay on the session to validate logs and latency — happy to block 30 minutes. If you prefer, here’s a short runbook and a drive link with the MAP and checklist: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2b3C-example-MAP

Attachments: redwood-onprem-checklist.pdf

If there are blockers from procurement/security I can coordinate with our compliance team and share an abbreviated SOC 2 evidence pack to speed review.

—Marcus
